headline: Threshold session nailed — 3x14min delivered at target HR, compliance 105%
summary: Strong execution: all three 14min reps held 163-170bpm (165-169bpm per interval_summary), cadence 172+ spm target roughly met (avg 85rpm cadence reading is per-foot so ~170spm), max HR 173 stayed under the 172bpm rep-1 safety cap. Full 1h32 done, load booked at 90 (vs 105 estimated — expected, since intervals.icu undercounts short high-intensity work by 20-25%; RPE 5/feel 2 and clean HR bands are the real signal here, not the load number). No pain flagged, no ITB signal. This was the best-executed quality session of the week after Sunday's easy run undershot (21 vs prescribed) and Monday's travel-day Bucharest run was solid but easy.
flags: Wellness this morning was excellent (HRV 72, RHR 45, sleep 6h18) — no gating was needed, and none was applied.

Watch the grey-zone pattern: this week's easy/shakeout days (Sun 21, prior Sun 18) have been underdelivered while quality sessions keep overdelivering — today's session continues that trend, which is fine for fitness but worth naming before it becomes habitual under-recovery.
04:00 airport Thursday — protect sleep the next two nights per plan notes.
suggestedChange: None needed today — session matched prescription. Alberto may want to confirm whether the recurring pattern (easy days light, hard days full-or-over) should shift some load from quality into the shakeout days for Wk7, to bank more consistent CTL ramp.
